footer.description: A licensed staff-secure Level III residential treatment facility serving children ages 6–17 in Wake County, North Carolina.

faqs.q: What is a staff-secure Level III residential treatment facility?
faqs.a: Level III residential treatment offers 24-hour care in a structured, home-like setting.
We serve children and adolescents, ages 6–17.

about.heading: Therapy, in the shape of a home.

about.body2: Located in Wake County, North Carolina, we serve young people ages 6–17.
